parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The group ID. This parameter is required when **PushMode** is set to **GROUP_DEVICE**.
You can obtain the group ID from **Device Management** > **Group Management**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID. When **PushMode** is set to **SINGLE_DEVICE**, you must specify either this parameter or the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**.

> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** tab of the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the product.

parameters.name: ProjectCode
parameters.description: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).

parameters.name: PushMode
parameters.description:
The push mode. Valid values:

- **ALL**: pushes to all devices.

- **SINGLE_DEVICE**: pushes to a single device.

- **GROUP_DEVICE**: pushes to devices in a group.

parameters.name: SpeechCodeList
parameters.description:
The list of speech corpus IDs to push. You can call [QuerySpeechList](~~217576~~) to obtain the IDs.

N is an integer. Valid values: 1 to 100. A maximum of 100 speech corpora can be pushed at a time.
